author: Brandjuh
name: CuffTranscribe
short: Transcribe voice memos, audio attachments and live voice channels with the Groq Whisper API.
description: Turns Discord voice memos and attached audio files into written statements using Groq's Whisper models, translated to English by default. Automatic transcription of voice messages, an on-demand `transcribe now` command, per-channel scoping, duration and daily caps, and a budget guard that mirrors Groq's published free-tier rate limits. Live voice is supported too: `[p]transcribe join` (or auto-join) puts the bot in a voice channel and writes the conversation into the paired text channel, batching speech toward Groq's 10-second billing floor. Live listening and the Audio (music) cog cannot use voice in the same guild at the same time. Requires a Groq API key: `[p]set api groq api_key,<key>`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store message content or audio. Audio attachments — and, while a live voice session is active, short in-memory captures of speech from the voice channel — are sent to the Groq API (a third party) for transcription and the resulting text is posted back to the channel; neither is stored by the cog. Per guild it stores: configuration settings, anonymous API-usage timestamps for rate limiting, and a list of user IDs whose audio should never be transcribed. Users can be removed from that list via Red's data deletion requests.
install_msg: Thanks for installing CuffTranscribe. Set a Groq API key with `[p]set api groq api_key,<key>`, then run `[p]transcribe` for the status of the transcription desk. Live voice: `[p]transcribe join` records your current voice channel into the paired text channel; auto-join is on by default. Note: live listening and the Audio (music) cog cannot use voice at the same time.
